rows.grounds: Compound dvādaśa (twelve) + arṇa (syllable/letter); describes a mantra of twelve syllables.
Compound khaḍga (sword) + mantra (mantra); names the specific mantra.
Sandhi-split yaḥ (who) + japet (should-recite) + dvādaśa-akṣaram (twelve-syllabled); refers to recitation of the twelve-syllable form.
